trigger_condition: HTTP 401/403 response has unsupported or malformed Content-Encoding.
guard_snippet: Classify refusal status and pause the host before decoding; retain encoding failure separately.
potential_consequence: Decoding failure hides the refusal; subsequent captures still request the same hostname.

trigger_condition: HTTP 429 includes Retry-After but its body cannot be decoded.
guard_snippet: Record status-based host cooldown before decoding.
potential_consequence: Subsequent captures can request the hostname before its required cooldown expires.

trigger_condition: Robots returns 403, a challenge, or server failure with unavailable acknowledgement enabled.
guard_snippet: Distinguish missing, security refusal and unreachable policy; limit acknowledgement to normal missing/empty policy.
potential_consequence: The operator flag authorizes content requests after an unresolved refusal or unreachable policy.

trigger_condition: An allowed FRA URL redirects to a robots-disallowed path on the same origin.
guard_snippet: Check the redirect destination's access and robots decisions before following.
potential_consequence: The destination is requested before its robots restrictions are checked.

trigger_condition: Robots permits a seeded page without a reviewed terms/access scope decision.
guard_snippet: Require a current exact-scope terms/access decision before content retrieval.
potential_consequence: Collection proceeds using robots allowance as its only recorded access gate.

trigger_condition: A page returns 401/403 before another seeded URL on the same hostname.
guard_snippet: Pause the affected host and skip its remaining batch URLs.
potential_consequence: Collection continues on the hostname after a security or authentication refusal.

trigger_condition: A page returns 429 with Retry-After before another same-host URL.
guard_snippet: Honor Retry-After and defer remaining host work when the wait exceeds budget.
potential_consequence: The next request uses ordinary pacing and ignores the rate-limit deadline.

trigger_condition: A verified institution has a website without a scoped acquisition decision.
guard_snippet: Route collection through the governed collector with current scoped decisions.
potential_consequence: This executable collector requests pages without robots, terms or scoped access checks.

trigger_condition: A repeated institution crawl changes content at the same local artifact path.
guard_snippet: Store raw content immutably by hash or unique run identifier.
potential_consequence: Earlier database hashes refer to raw paths whose bytes have been overwritten.

trigger_condition: HTTP 200 contains a challenge, login shell or non-HTML document.
guard_snippet: Preserve response metadata and classify access/content before registering evidence.
potential_consequence: Gated or diagnostic responses are registered as public HTML product-page evidence.

trigger_condition: Required words occur in a passage denying the seeded financing claim.
guard_snippet: Keep candidate passages pending analyst confirmation of the claim and entity roles.
potential_consequence: A denial becomes verified_page_evidence with unsupported seller and financier labels attached.

trigger_condition: A 401/403 access refusal has unsupported or corrupt Content-Encoding, so decoding fails before the hostname is paused.
guard_snippet: Exercise HTTP 401/403 with unsupported br and corrupt gzip; assert login_gated/blocked_by_security and zero additional transport calls for the next same-host capture.
potential_consequence: Known refusal is lost and the CLI continues the host batch. Fixture 403/br and 401/br each left paused empty; the next URL was requested.

None combines refusal status with decoding failure. Local fake transport/DNS/clock/sleep reproduction; no provider requests.

trigger_condition: A JavaScript document shell has more than 20 characters of navigation/footer text and no document content.
guard_snippet: Exercise an empty application root with a rendering script and navigation/footer; require render-needed or partial status rather than acquisition_complete=true.
potential_consequence: The CLI returns successful capture for site chrome, bypassing the missing-document rendering follow-up. Applicability remains unreviewed but does not identify the extraction gap.
